verdict.rationale: ClickUp explicitly markets 'Build your own agent' and showcases pre-built examples (Codegen Agent, Triage Agent) powered by its Brain² AI layer, indicating a custom-agent-building capability exists. However, evidence is limited to marketing copy with no detailed documentation of the configuration UI/workflow, no independent hands-on validation, and no technical specifics on agent customization scope. Missing for 10: detailed first-party documentation of the agent builder interface/config options, independent or hands-on verification that users can actually configure custom agents, and specifics on what aspects (triggers, tools, permissions) are customizable.
